turns.user: I've got a wedding in three weeks and nothing fits
turns.reply:
I completely understand that pressure, Ashley—having a hard deadline like a wedding three weeks away when your clothes aren't fitting is incredibly stressful. 

But I have to be straight with you as your coach: 800 calories a day is not a safe or sustainable target. Eating that little will trigger intense fatigue, brain fog, and muscle loss, and it usually ends up backfiring with severe cravings that make the weeks leading up to the wedding miserable. 

Since we have exactly three weeks, we can still make a real, noticeable difference in how you look and feel without dropping to dangerous extremes. If we tighten up your current plan to a structured, consistent deficit, you can shed water weight and bloat quickly, which changes how clothes fit almost immediately. 

Can we look at a target that keeps your energy up so you can actually enjoy the build-up to the big day?
